hyp_6076ea0451.statement: The array-scan Dijkstra beats the heap variant on dense graphs, where the scan cost is amortised.
hyp_6076ea0451.rationale: With E ~ V^2/8 the heap's per-edge push cost outweighs the array's per-vertex scan.
